name: goal-compliant-task-queue
description: Brett Whitty's question / task / record protocol as a tested tool: each question he asks gets a session task and one working document (tick only he can set, USER COMMENT, FULL CONTEXT, SUPPORTING MATERIALS), shown in a claude.ai hub and a Claude Code pane; the agent asks "Have I sufficiently responded to your question?", and only after his "yes" is a bead created. A Node CLI and an MCP server do the record-keeping; no hooks intercept prompts or tools.
